Implemented a Rust (stable, 2021) CLI G-code simulator under `output/` with an empty `[dependencies]` section.

- Cargo project: `output/Cargo.toml`
- Entry point: `output/src/main.rs`
- Key modules: `output/src/sim.rs`, `output/src/gcode.rs`, `output/src/expr.rs`, `output/src/params.rs`, `output/src/tool_table.rs`

Build/run:
- `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --input <file.ngc> --output <out.json> [--tool-table <toolfile>] [--block-delete] [--carousel-slots <n>] [--parameter-input <varfile>] [--parameter-output <varfile>] [--probe-box x_min x_max y_min y_max z_min z_max] [--probe-tool <tool>] [--trace-output <trace.json> (--trace-time-step <s> | --trace-distance-step <in> | --trace-position-tolerance <in>)]`

It writes the required result JSON to `--output` on both success and error, and writes the trace JSON to `--trace-output` (if provided) on both success and error.
